# What’s the best Garmin golf laser rangefinder for you?


September 2, 2026


### *Ready to get the metrics you need to improve your game? Pick a laser rangefinder that’s right for you.*


Tired of guessing which golf club to use because you can’t tell where the pin is on the green? What if you could account for wind and uphill or downhill shots? What if you could understand where the hazards are with a quick glance at a screen?


With Garmin, you can.


Now you’ll know if you should or shouldn’t hit a driver. You’ll know how to avoid different hazards.


It’s time to upgrade your golf game with a rangefinder. We’re here to help.


## Why should you buy a golf rangefinder?


Rangefinders tell you how far away the pin is, helping you choose your golf club and plan your path to the hole.


Garmin rangefinders — such as[Approach® Z10](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1952393/pn/010-04328-00/) ,[Approach Z30](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1411809) or[Approach Z82](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/672620#overview) — use a laser to calculate the distance, ensuring greater accuracy. For example, while a golf watch can give you the distance to the front, middle and back of the green, a rangefinder gives you the precise distance to the pin (and several other features designed to bring out the best in your game, but we’ll get to those below).


## What’s the best Garmin golf rangefinder for you?


Garmin offers a full lineup of laser rangefinders: Approach Z10, Approach Z30 and Approach Z82. All include an adjustable eyepiece that allows you to focus the screen,[PlaysLike Distance](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/golf-science/distance-measurement/playslike/) and 6X magnification. They come with a carrying case and a carabiner so you can clip them to your bag. Approach Z10 and Z30 also have a magnetic cart mount, so you can snap your rangefinder to your golf cart.


If you lose your rangefinder on the fairway (or anywhere, let’s be honest), you can use Find My Garmin through the[Garmin Golf™ app](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/590068) to locate it.


Plus, the PlaysLike Distance feature will adjust your yardage based on whether your target is uphill or downhill.


Tournament mode, which disables the[PinPointer](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/golf-science/distance-measurement/pinpointer/) and PlaysLike Distance features, is shown by an external indicator light and can be turned on and off. This means you can still take your rangefinder to tournaments.


Here’s how a few of the different rangefinders’ features break down.


**Laser range arc:** The Approach Z10 and Z30 rangefinders offer the[Range Relay feature](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/golf-science/distance-measurement/range-relay/) , which sends distances to your[compatible Garmin](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/golf-gps-devices-smartwatches/?FILTER_FEATURE_GOLFRANGERELAY=true) device or the Garmin Golf app. On Approach Z82, your arc will appear through your viewfinder. The laser range arc shows everything in play at the laser-ranged distance — even hazards.


**Viewfinder built-ins** : Approach Z82 has built-in GPS with more than 43,000 full-color, preloaded courses, the green view feature with distance to the front, middle and back of the green, hazard view, and PinPointer — all in the viewfinder. When paired to your compatible phone, Approach Z82 also displays wind speed and direction in the viewfinder.


**Battery life:** Approach Z10 and Z30 have a replaceable CR2 battery that can last up to a year. The Approach Z82 battery is rechargeable with up to 15 hours of battery life in GPS mode.


**Accuracy:** The laser range to the flag on Approach Z10 is 350 yards, while Approach Z30 ranges 400 yards. Both have accuracy within 1 yard. Approach Z82 can measure distances from up to 450 yards and will give you a reading within 10″ of the flag.


**Water-resistant** : Approach Z10 is IPX4-rated, meaning it’s built to withstand splashing and light rain. Your Approach Z30 or Z82 rangefinder has been tested to withstand submersion in up to a meter of water.


To get the distance to the pin from up to 350 yards away, consider Approach Z10. For slightly longer ranging and a higher water rating, go for Approach Z30. Both are the perfect companions to your[Garmin golf smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/whats-the-best-garmin-golf-watch-for-me/) or handheld. If you want the most accurate reading within 10″ of the flag, plus built-in GPS with more than 43,000 preloaded, full-color course maps right from your viewfinder, go for Approach Z82.


Ready to take your best shot and improve your golf game?
